requirements.title: Every runtime SuperAgent already ships stays usable
requirements.statement: The native backend MUST remain available for all nine runtimes in runtime-catalog.mjs (codex, traex, claude, volc, pi, durable, dsh, opencode, agy), and no change in this work may remove or deprecate a native adapter.

acceptance.given: the nine runtimes declared in runtime-catalog.mjs
acceptance.when: the matrix and the native contract suite are read
acceptance.then: every runtime has a native entry with evidence and no runtime is missing

requirements.title: OAR candidates are declared where an adapter exists
requirements.statement: Runtimes covered by OAR MUST have an `oar` matrix entry with a status of available, pending or unavailable, and a reason; availability requires E2 or better evidence.

acceptance.given: a runtime with an OAR adapter but no verified probe
acceptance.then: its oar status is pending and it cannot become a candidate yet

requirements.title: Uncovered runtimes are marked native-only
requirements.statement: A runtime without an OAR adapter (traex, volc) MUST be marked native-only in the matrix and MUST NOT be described as OAR-supported in docs or UI.

acceptance.when: the isolation mapping is asked for an oar backend
acceptance.then: the answer is ineligible with a reason, never a silent fallback

requirements.title: Backend selection has no hardcoded default
requirements.statement: The selector MUST choose between eligible candidates from their constraint results and scores; it MUST NOT return a backend that is merely the product default, and `auto` MUST be the only default configuration value.

acceptance.given: two eligible candidates with different scores
acceptance.then: the higher score wins even when the other backend has the lower tie-break priority

requirements.title: No eligible candidate fails closed and explains why
requirements.statement: When every candidate fails a hard constraint the selector MUST throw NoEligibleBackendError with each candidate's constraint code and reason; it MUST NOT fall back to a default backend.

acceptance.given: all candidates stale or missing a required capability
acceptance.then: the error lists every candidate and no session is opened

requirements.title: Decisions are reproducible
requirements.statement: For the same request, candidates, policy version and clock the selector MUST produce the same decision and the same tie-break, including across process restarts.

acceptance.when: decide runs twice or is replayed from a fixture
acceptance.then: the chosen backend and component scores are identical

requirements.title: Every decision is recorded
requirements.statement: A decision MUST carry the decision id, policy and evidence versions, every candidate's constraint results and scores, the chosen backend, the reason code and the fallback chain.

acceptance.then: all required fields are present and policyVersion equals the policy used

requirements.title: Native stays the behavioral baseline
requirements.statement: Contract tests MUST assert native behavior first; an OAR candidate MAY only be admitted when it passes the same assertions or declares a documented difference.

acceptance.then: the result is pass, an explicit difference, or ineligible

requirements.title: Native-only capabilities stay hard constraints
requirements.statement: Capabilities OAR does not model (prepared rotation, authority token, turn notice, loop breaker) MUST be represented as required capabilities, so a candidate without them is ineligible rather than degraded.

requirements.title: Switching happens only at a session boundary
requirements.statement: A re-evaluation MUST NOT move an in-flight turn; a backend change takes effect only on a new session or a resumable rotation.

acceptance.given: a sticky decision and no declared re-evaluation event

requirements.title: SuperAgent owns memory for every runtime
requirements.statement: Because the daemon owns recall and commit, an OAR-launched runtime MUST have its own OpenViking plugin inert: memory, auto recall, auto capture, auto commit and takeover all off, with workspace peer off, via the existing openVikingAgentEnv switches.

acceptance.then: the six required switches are "0" and the instance ovConfig is set

requirements.title: Isolation is declared, mapped and unproven means ineligible
requirements.statement: Each runtime's ovIsolation mechanism MUST map to an OAR session channel; until that mapping is verified against the real CLI, the OAR backend MUST be ineligible for that runtime.

acceptance.then: the answer is ineligible because per-session env cannot reach an in-process extension

requirements.title: Evidence has a floor and an expiry
requirements.statement: A candidate MUST have evidence at or above the policy level, no older than maxAgeDays, and confidence at or above the floor; otherwise it fails C8.

acceptance.given: E2 evidence older than the policy window
acceptance.then: C8 fails with the age in the reason

requirements.title: The spec closes: requirements, tests, tasks and gates
requirements.statement: Every requirement MUST have acceptance criteria and at least one test; every test MUST point back to a requirement; every task MUST have requirements, outputs and verify commands; gates MUST declare argv checks and evidence.

acceptance.then: there are zero duplicate, orphan or dangling links

requirements.title: A gate is a command plus hashed evidence
requirements.statement: Running a gate MUST execute only allowed argv commands, record each check, and verify that evidence files still match the hashes from the passing run.

acceptance.given: a passing gate report and a modified evidence file
acceptance.when: the gate is re-run without writing
acceptance.then: verification fails on the hash mismatch
